open_post.query: SELECT p.id, p.body, p.created_at, p.like_count FROM posts p WHERE p.id = $1

profile.query: SELECT p.id, p.body, p.created_at, p.like_count FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT $2

like_write.query: WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO likes (post_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING post_id ) UPDATE posts AS p SET like_count = p.like_count + $3 FROM inserted AS i WHERE p.id = i.post_id

new_post.query: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, body, created_at) VALUES ($1, repeat($3, $2), now())

other.query: SELECT extract($1 FROM now())::bigint, coalesce(wait_event_type, $2), coalesce(wait_event, $3), count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = $4 AND state = $5 AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
